evals.prompt: review my branch before I open the PR
evals.expected_output: Focused-mode round under .tmp/review/<branch>/01-initial/ with scope.md recording the merge-base sha, identical prompt-C.md and prompt-X.md built from preamble-code + bugs + impl, finder outputs, merged.md, verify output and report.md; chat brief ends with an AskUserQuestion naming findings by title; no files outside .tmp/ changed.
expectations: The response states the scope (branch vs main/master) and mode (focused) before the finders run
A round folder .tmp/review/<task>/01-initial/ exists containing scope.md, context.md, prompt-C.md, prompt-X.md, finder-C.md, merged.md and report.md
prompt-C.md and prompt-X.md differ only in the final id-prefix line
Either finder-X.md holds codex findings in the template, or report.md records 'missing reviewer: X' with a reason
Every finding in report.md carries a verdict, and only critical/major confirmed, refined or unverified findings appear under Gating
The turn ends with an AskUserQuestion whose options name findings by title, and git status shows no changes outside .tmp/

evals.prompt: can you do a full review of the last commit, I want every angle covered
evals.expected_output: Full-mode round on commit-<sha> with base <sha>^, finders B, Q, D (Claude) and X (codex adversarial), verifiers grouped by top-level directory (max 3), report with sources shown per finding.
expectations: scope.md records base as the parent of the reviewed commit and the diff command git diff <sha>^ <sha>
prompt-B.md, prompt-Q.md, prompt-D.md and prompt-X.md exist and carry the lenses from the Modes table (Q has quality, minimal and security; X has adversarial)
At most three verify-prompt-<n>.md files exist
Findings raised by more than one finder show combined sources in the report heading

evals.prompt: review the plan in docs/plans/ before I execute it
evals.expected_output: Plan-mode round on the plan file: prompts from preamble-plan + plan + grounding, findings located in the plan or the repo, no Pre-existing section, brief ending with AskUserQuestion.
expectations: The mode is plan and scope.md names the plan document's absolute path, not a diff command
prompt-C.md and prompt-X.md contain the plan and grounding lenses and the plan severity bar
